authorization.notes: This runner consumes only a GPU already attached to the process. It contains no cloud provisioning or purchase path.

truth_boundary.purpose: single-GPU execution, AMP, transfer, optimizer, checkpoint/resume, metrics and post-training inference mechanics
truth_boundary.bf16: Use --precision bf16 only on CUDA devices positively accepted by the incumbent D02 precision resolver.
truth_boundary.fp16: Default pilot mode uses CUDA autocast float16 plus GradScaler while model and AdamW master-weight storage remain fp32.
